# anthropic_api_key (Data Source)

Reads one API key record by id. The secret is never returned. Requires `admin_api_key` or `oauth_token`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_api_key" "example" {
  id = "apikey_01ExampleApiKeyId00000000"
}

output "api_key_status" {
  value = data.anthropic_api_key.example.status
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) API key id (`apikey_...`).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `created_by_id` (String) Creator id.
- `created_by_type` (String) Creator type (`user` or `service_account`).
- `expires_at` (String) Expiry timestamp, if any.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `partial_key_hint` (String) Redacted key hint.
- `principal_id` (String) Principal id.
- `principal_type` (String) `user_actor` or `service_account_actor`.
- `scope_type` (String) `workspace` or `organization`.
- `status` (String) `active`, `inactive`, `archived` or `expired`.
- `workspace_id` (String) Scoped workspace id, if any.
